event: A thud sound occurs, and the task is to determine its location relative to a hypothetical robot standing by a double-basin sink and facing an electric cooktop.

sounding_object.description: The sounding object is the front door of the house. It is a dark brown/black door, likely wooden or metal, featuring ornate black wrought iron scrollwork over textured glass panels. It is a standard exterior door size.

reference_object.description: A stainless steel, undermount, double-basin rectangular kitchen sink with a modern tap, set into a granite countertop on the central kitchen island.

facing_object.description: A black glass-ceramic electric cooktop with multiple circular burner markings, built into the granite countertop of the kitchen island, located to the physical left of the double-basin sink.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the double-basin rectangular sink and tap and facing the electric cooktop, when the thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
